Game Overview

In Kitty Kuro, the core idea is straightforward: help Kitty Kuro escape her temperamental chef mother through the whimsical Candy Forest. Dash across jellybeans and cake islands, dodging sweet yet sticky obstacles. Collect candies and the golden key to unlock freedom in a thrilling mix of skillful jumps and strategic moves.
